name: crux
description: Crux: durable repo memory, evidence-grade experiments, and an explicit operating model — one plugin, profile-gated. Capture profile: write-once raw capture, distilled linked notes, an indexed wiki layer, an append-only journal of write-once fragments, and a compiled status dashboard, enforced by hooks. Experiments profile adds the hypothesis loop: spec first, one variable, fixed budgets, binary assertions, mechanical keep/discard/refine verdicts. Modeling profile adds the operating-model lifecycle: adopt (mine a repo and its recorded sessions into a SCHEMA-shaped model), observe (trace sessions against it), evaluate (audit it), compile (regenerate executable artifacts from it), verify (A/B-test interventions), and run (execute compiled flows). /crux:init scaffolds your repo per profile; capture triggers on phrases like "note this". 0.2.0 adds the environment-health doctor (typed credential-flap classification with a frozen remediation ladder) plus the verdict-forcing review cadence over open ledger rows. 0.3.0 adds the audited GitHub-issues intake (CRLF-normalizing transport adapter, templated replies, allowlist-confined teardown — proven live), the directive-intake kit (declare acceptance assertions before mutating, with closure lint and On-close commitment emitter), the report-only ethics extension to preflight, the channel consent discipline and templates, and the CI scaffold reference. 0.4.0 adds the decision kit (one append-only ledger-backed decision store; AskUserQuestion-grammar cards rendered first on the dashboard and into decisions.html; resolve by one CLI line committing just the resolution row; decided-by/at/commit derive from git, never stored), the clarity canon (communication contract + house-vocabulary glosses + clarity lint), and the counted observatory: stall signals, typed flow-waste detection, per-user identity attribution with the YOURS/OTHERS lens, metric trend derivation, the workflow-facts loop with the gate-to-GWT harvester, and the per-keep case-study renderer.
